scope: Game metadata detail and server-paginated game history; mandatory login and Internet

build.local_jvm_workaround: Ignored tcp-only javaagent described in PHASE2.md; isolated Gradle daemon registry after shared daemon received a stop command; neither workaround is included in APK or CI

new_checks: Game page / play / existing game / back preserves pages
Refresh identical metadata rereads the first page
Missing and forbidden metadata never fetch game history
Failed next page retains rows and cursor for retry
Offline and logout remove the game; reconnect reads fresh metadata
Existing game with empty history is distinct from a missing game

screenshot_method: Compose root, excluding system bars; synthetic fixtures only

query_checks.history: Existing HistoryFilters(gameId=id) before limit=50 with played_at DESC,unsigned UUID DESC
query_checks.game_response_validation: Zero or one row, same UUID, strict generated decoder

backend_query_probes.reason: Uses existing audited games fields and previously validated game_id history filtering; no new query operators or remote schema changes

review.method: Read-only static review of navigation, lifecycle, readers and test coverage

ci_at_local_evidence_capture.current_increment: Created after commit/push; consult Actions for its final result
ci_at_local_evidence_capture.workflow: Node evidence, debug build, JVM tests and lint; no emulator instrumentation

remaining_1_0_effort.unit: effective hours; planning estimate, not elapsed calendar time

known_ui_limitations: Existing bottom-navigation label Statistiche is clipped in portrait at about 376 dp and 130% font scale; refine large-font navigation labels before stable release
not_verified: Real account login and comparison with real group data
Physical phone, API minimum 26, TalkBack and tablet
Player detail and images; phase 4 writes and phase 5 signed release
emulator_note: Only dedicated emulator-5582 controlled; settings restored and emulator stopped. Existing emulator-5584 and emulator-5586 left untouched.
